1962343.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Park City
1962343.note: Chabad Lubavitch of Utah's own page ('Chabad Lubavitch of Utah has opened a center in Park City'): 'In September 2012 Chabad Lubavitch of Utah added a full-time Chabad presence in Park City. Rabbi Yudi and Mrs. Devori Steiger serve as directors of Chabad of Park City'. Earlier entry: Chabad.org (via COLlive): 'Since 2013, Rabbi Yudi and Devori Steiger have directed the Park City Chabad-Lubavitch Community Center.' One source; a summary of other coverage said Chabad came to Park City in 2012, but no source for that was found. Checked (Nov 7): the Utah page gives Sept 2012 and Chabad.org 'since 2013', a year apart, so medium; the year taken is the specific one.

117736.name: Chabad of Vermont
117736.note: Chabad.org (20 Dec 2018): 'In the winter of 1983' Rabbi Yitzchok and Zeesy Raskin were appointed by the Rebbe 'as the new Chabad-Lubavitch emissaries to Vermont'; one of their first acts was a menorah at City Hall. A Chabad article also says they opened the center in 1983, but the Brattleboro Reformer (2012) and Front Porch Forum say 1984. Rabbi Eliyahu and Draizy Junik, now its directors, came in 2014. Checked (Nov 7): its own site (https://www.chabadvt.org/templates/articlecco_cdo/aid/447745/jewish/About-Chabad-of-Burlington.htm): 'Founded by Rabbi Yitzchok and Zeesy Raskin in 1984'; so appointed in the winter of 1983 and founded 1984 — the year taken is the center's own (was 1983), medium as the two are a year apart.
